entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. How can I help you today?
Yes, hi. I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little over two weeks ago and it's just not working out for me.
I understand. Let me pull up your account. Can I please have your phone number or email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you. Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse on October 26th. And today is November 10th. To process the return, do you have the original packaging and receipt?
Yes, I have everything. That's not the problem! The problem is this thing doesn't track my heart rate accurately at all! It's useless to me. I want my money back!

I understand your frustration. I'm looking at our return policy, and unfortunately, our standard return window is 10 days from the date of purchase. Since it's been 15 days, a full refund isn't possible at this time. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
Ten days?! Are you kidding me? That's ridiculous! I spent good money on this VeloBand Pulse! There has to be something you can do. This is unacceptable!
I understand. While I can't offer a full refund outside of the return window, let me see if I can offer you store credit instead. One moment please...

Okay, I've checked, and while I can't make a policy exception for a full refund in this case, I can offer you store credit for the full purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. You can use it towards another VeloFit product that better suits your needs. Would that be acceptable?
Hmm… So I could get a different tracker or something?
Exactly! You can apply the store credit to any item we have in stock. Perhaps another model of fitness tracker or even some VeloFit apparel.
Okay, fine. Store credit is better than nothing. How does that work?

Great! I've processed the store credit to your account. You can use it immediately online or in any VeloFit store. You'll just need to provide your phone number or email address at checkout. I’ll also send you an email with the details of your store credit.
Alright, I see the email. Thank you for helping me with this. I appreciate you finding a solution.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's all. Thanks again!
Have a great day and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
